name: Camp NEOFA
description_short: Coed overnight camp on Trues Pond in Montville, run by the Northeast Odd Fellows' Association for four one week sessions, Sunday noon to Saturday noon. Campers swim, canoe, kayak, fish, try archery, crafts and field sports, with themed evening events; a day camp option is also offered.
refund_policy_summary: A $75 deposit must come with the application; it is transferable but not refundable.
